title: Scalar compatibility of normalized strict direct-image/limit maps
statement:
Let $(A,I)$ be an adic datum $d$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], let $f:U\to T$ be any scheme map, and let $M$ be any object of the derived category of strict towers of completed-ring modules. Write $L_V$ and $L'_V$ for derived inverse limits over completed and constant coefficient sheaves. Write $r_V$ and $r_V^{\mathrm{Tow}}$ for exact scalar restriction and its tower version, with the specified comparison $\lambda_V:r_V L_V\to L'_V r_V^{\mathrm{Tow}}$ [def-cbc-completed-open-scalar-quotient-interface], [def-cbc-strict-tower-realization-comparisons], [lem-cbc-exact-product-functor-strict-limit]. Let $P,P^{\mathrm{Tow}}$ be the completed direct images, and $P',P'^{\mathrm{Tow}}$ the constant ones. Let $c:P L_U\to L_T P^{\mathrm{Tow}}$ be the specified direct-image/limit comparison [prop-weil-pbc-direct-image-limits], and let $c':P'L'_U\to L'_T P'^{\mathrm{Tow}}$ be its constant version, defined by conjugating the constant/pullback comparison. Let $d_f:r_T P\to P'r_U$ and $d_f^{\mathrm{Tow}}:r_T^{\mathrm{Tow}}P^{\mathrm{Tow}}\to P'^{\mathrm{Tow}}r_U^{\mathrm{Tow}}$ be the normalized scalar/direct-image isomorphisms [lem-weil-pbc-strict-tower-exchange-mate-normalization]. Then
$$L'_T(d_f^{\mathrm{Tow}}(M))\,\lambda_{T,P^{\mathrm{Tow}}M}\,r_T(c_M)
=c'_{r_U^{\mathrm{Tow}}M}\,P'(\lambda_{U,M})\,d_{f,L_UM}.$$
All comparisons are the published unit-normalized ones. No properness, completeness, finite-origin, or degree-bound hypothesis is imposed on $M$.

proof.text: Apply the existing flat scalar direct-image/limit coherence theorem to the pro-etale ringed morphism with constant and completed coefficients. Constant/completed equivalence gives flat scalar maps. Restriction leaves the underlying additive sheaf unchanged, so ordinary scalar/limit comparisons are fixed by the limit projections. Its exact flat left adjoint makes scalar restriction preserve K-injective towers.

Identify the chosen derived comparisons by their universal-unit normalizations: the tower and individual scalar/direct-image maps are exchangeResPush and cbcRealizationResPush; the scalar/limit map is the constant-diagram mate identified with the normalized ordinary-limit comparison; and both direct-image/limit maps are the specified adjunction conjugates. The first conclusion of the flat-scalar theorem gives the displayed equality on any derived strict tower. In particular the same proof works for zero, empty, and identity cases.

theorem strictTowerScalarPushLimitCoherence {U T : Scheme.{t}} (f : U ⟶ T)
    (M : DerivedCategory (exchangeTowers U (d.completedRing U))) :
    (cbcRealizationRes d T).mapDerivedCategory.map
        ((d.directImageRlimIso f).hom.app M) ≫
      (cbcRealizationResLimit d T).hom.app ((d.towerPush f).obj M) ≫
      (completedRlim T (exchangeConstantRing T A)).map
        ((exchangeResPush d f).hom.app M) =
    (cbcRealizationResPush d f).hom.app ((completedRlim U (d.completedRing U)).obj M) ≫
      (ProEtale.StrictTower.moduleDirectImage A f).rightDerivedFunctor.map
        ((cbcRealizationResLimit d U).hom.app M) ≫
      (cbcRealizationPushLimit (A := A) f).hom.app ((exchangeTowerRes d U).obj M)
